shortDescription: Black gothic choker necklace with source-listed fabric, a 30 cm base and 10 cm extension. Check the selected width and package contents before choosing.
contentHtml:
Black gothic choker: length, fabric and details

For a dark gothic jewelry look, this black necklace is documented as the Black 1 variant. The reviewed source describes fabric with velvet and lace details and lists a lobster clasp. These descriptions are attributed to the listing, not an independent fiber-composition test.

What length does the listing give?

It states a 30 cm base plus a 10 cm extension. Compare that base with your own measurement; the stated length does not establish collar width or guarantee fit.

How many pieces are included?

The exact package count is unconfirmed. A decorative or layered appearance is not evidence that several separate necklaces are supplied.

Does the photograph establish the material?

No. The AI-styled image shows the look but cannot verify fiber content or dimensions. Confirm the selected width and package contents before choosing.

shortDescription: Adjustable gothic necklace in black fabric, with a source-listed 30 cm base and 8 cm extension. Its two-layer design does not confirm two separate necklaces.
contentHtml:
Adjustable gothic necklace: the Black 1 fabric variant

This black fabric necklace is the B0D9GWX6L6 selection. The site owner confirmed fabric for this necklace on October 30, 2026. The listing body also describes fabric, while a separate material field says leather. That clarification applies only to this necklace, not to other products.

What is the listed adjustment range?

The reviewed text gives a 30 cm base plus an 8 cm extension for Black 1. Collar width remains unconfirmed, and the measurements do not guarantee a particular fit.

Does two-layer mean two separate necklaces?

No separate-piece count is confirmed. The source describes a two-layer design; that does not establish two independently wearable necklaces in the package.

Which components are metal?

A metal field names copper and the clasp field says lobster. These fields do not establish the fabric's fiber composition or the material of every component.

shortDescription: Gold-tone lariat necklace with a source-listed 16.5-inch length, 2-inch extension and lobster clasp. Separate drop length and exact package contents remain unconfirmed.
contentHtml:
Gold-tone lariat necklace: neck length versus drop

A lariat introduces a vertical drop to the necklace shape. For source identifier B0BW91BKR4, the reviewed text lists a 16.5-inch necklace plus a 2-inch extension and a lobster clasp. It separately lists brass in the metal field and describes 14K gold plating.

Does the listed length establish the hanging drop?

The source does not give a separate drop measurement. Do not add an assumed drop length to the neck portion or measure it from the styled photo.

Is it solid gold?

No solid-gold composition is verified. The source describes plating, which does not establish solid gold or guarantee the durability of the finish.

Which variant and package does this cover?

The exact lariat variant and package count still need confirmation. Treat the listed measurements as source references for selection, not a specification for every option.

Use the necklace length and drop guide for comparison and the product source directory to locate the original listing.

shortDescription: Layered chain necklace with four source-described link styles and distinct measurements. Confirm the selected combination; the listing does not establish a four-chain bundle.
contentHtml:
Layered chain necklace: check each link and combination

This gold-tone layered chain necklace selection is documented under B0F2M4CNWH. The source names four link styles with different measurements: herringbone, 16.5 inches and 4 mm; Cuban, 15 inches and 3 mm; box, 15 inches and 1.2 mm; twisted, 18 inches and 3 mm.

Are all four chains in the selected bundle?

That is not confirmed. Four styles described in one listing do not establish that every chosen variant includes four separate necklaces.

Are their materials the same?

The source identifies gold-plated brass for the herringbone chain and lists a lobster clasp. It does not establish identical base metals for every style.

Can all the chains be adjusted?

An extension measurement for each chain is unconfirmed. Check the exact combination, included pieces and each extension before planning a layered look.

Compare the figures in the necklace layering guide and find the original listing through the product source directory.

shortDescription: Hoop earring set with three source-listed pairs, inner diameters of 0.31, 0.39 and 0.46 inches, and hinged closures. Component materials and weight need separate checks.
contentHtml:
Hoop earring set: three pairs, measured inside

The source for this gold-tone hoop earring set describes three pairs in different sizes. Its stated inner diameters are 0.31, 0.39 and 0.46 inches, and the closure field identifies a hinged snap. These are listing statements for B0D172FC5V, not measurements taken by FUBAO.

Are those outer diameters?

No. The description identifies inner diameters; overall outer size, hoop thickness and post dimensions remain unconfirmed.

Does a silver post mean a solid-silver hoop?

The metal field lists copper, while the description separately claims a sterling-silver post and 14K gold plating. Those component claims do not establish a solid-silver or solid-gold body.

Can I rely on the listed weight?

Not yet. One field shows 20 g, while text says less than 0.1 oz without a clear per-earring, pair or set basis. Wearable weight remains unresolved; no sensitive-ear guarantee is made.

Read the hoop size and component-material guide and locate this listing in the product source directory.
